messages.subject: Update to plotRefToTarget
parts:
Dear geomorph users,

please note an update has been implemented to the function
plotRefToTarget to allow the use of an outline with plotting method set
to "vectors" (which was previously limited only to "TPS" and "points").

Please install from github to access the new version of the function.

Antigoni
